title: Where the markup goes carousel

posts.caption:
Where the markup goes.
A typical retail price pays for a mall shop, large ad budgets and layers of resellers. We select finished pairs at local Pakistani workshops and sell them online, straight to your door. You keep the difference.
Same local craft. Zero retail markup.
